apikey.title: Connect to your AirGradient device
apikey.intro: To connect AirGradient via the cloud API, you need a place API token.
apikey.stepOpen: Open the AirGradient Dashboard.
apikey.stepToken: Enable API access, copy the token, and paste it below.
